summary: Defines a metric for variation in packet delay across Internet paths, based on differences in the one-way delay of selected packets. It works when the two measuring hosts have synchronized clocks and when they do not.

eli5.summary: Packets should arrive at steady times. This describes a way to measure how much their travel times wobble, which matters for voice and video.
